derived_for_module: ALIASES, not measurements. The run emitted its splits and its selected list per QUESTION (q1 ceiling / q2 floor); supply_demand/band_structure.py reads them at the top level, so: n_names = n_universe; selected = q1.selected + q2.selected (both empty); orientation/edges = {} because nothing was selected; splits[k].mdl = max(q1.splits[k].mdl, q2.splits[k].mdl), the weaker of the two resolutions, the same max() block_status already takes across splits; cohort_note = the study's own note (kept verbatim in cohort_note_study) plus the survivorship clause read from the survivorship block. Every q1/q2 block is untouched above.
